sermon.title: Where is He Who Has Been Born King of the Jews? 20181209
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message Pastor David G. Kincer says Jesus confirmed He is a king and that God planned to put His kingdom in people, not in a natural nation. We are the temple of God, the Spirit dwells in us, and nothing on earth or in darkness can stop what God is doing.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For unto us a Child is born, Unto us a Son is given; And the government will be upon His shoulder. And His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. Of the increase of His government and peace There will be no end, Upon the throne of David and over His kingdom, To order it and establish it with judgment and justice From that time forward, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.

Pilate therefore said to Him, “Are You a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say rightly that I am a king. For this cause I was born, and for this cause I have come into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth hears My voice.”

Now when He was asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them and said, “The kingdom of God does not come with observation; nor will they say, ‘See here!’ or ‘See there!’ For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you.”

faqs.question: Where is the kingdom of God?
faqs.answer: Jesus said the kingdom of God is within you.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now when He was asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them and said, “The kingdom of God does not come with observation; nor will they say, ‘See here!’ or ‘See there!’ For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you.”

faqs.question: Why do the Jews deny Jesus was the Messiah?
faqs.answer: He says they are still looking for the restoration of their natural kingdom.

faqs.question: What were the disciples wanting when they asked about restoring the kingdom?
faqs.answer: Their natural kingdom, but God came to build a spiritual kingdom within every one of us.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked Him, saying, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”

faqs.question: Do I have to go to Jerusalem or the Jordan?
faqs.answer: No. He says Jesus comes where you are.

faqs.question: What is the kingdom in us?
faqs.answer: His kingdom of righteousness, peace and joy.

faqs.question: Who has all power?
faqs.answer: Jesus is the big boss, underneath God the Father; all power in heaven and earth is given to Him.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.

faqs.question: Can I take anything to Jesus?
faqs.answer: Yes, because He has the power to answer your needs.

faqs.question: What are pastors and evangelists?
faqs.answer: Just vessels; Jesus is the one who changes lives.
